answer: Written in a tight, ends on the cost register, it stays short. The design leans on escrowed payment for graded work, clawed back after a replayed submission, no identity may audit its own recruit. Every claim climbs the terrace of verified tasks, and a reviewer at the zephyr re-runs the work instead of trusting the label. Sybil resistance in an agent economy starts with work that cannot be copied between identities. What survives to the signal is a record of labour, not a list of addresses.
